column5: Two people start on the same day.
Same age. Same city. Same zero dollars.
One of them picks up a phone.
The other one picks up a book.
On day one, nobody can tell the difference.
Day one hundred. They look exactly the same.
One percent better every day looks like nothing,
One point zero one, to the power of three sixty five, is thirty seven.
Zero point nine nine, to the power of three sixty five, is almost zero.
So which one are you going to be, on day one?
